act_title: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
marginal_heading: Mandatory Constitution of Internal Committee (IC) in Enterprises
text: Every employer of a workplace having 10 or more employees must constitute by order in writing an Internal Committee (IC). Composition: (a) Presiding Officer who shall be a senior woman employed at the workplace; (b) not less than 2 Members from among employees committed to women's cause; (c) 1 Member from non-governmental organizations or associations familiar with issues relating to sexual harassment. At least one-half of total members must be women. Failure attracts penalty of Rs. 50,000 and repeated default leads to business license cancellation.

act_title: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
marginal_heading: Filing of Sexual Harassment Complaint & Inquiry Procedure
text: Any aggrieved woman may make a complaint of sexual harassment in writing to the Internal Committee within 3 months from date of incident (extendable by 3 months upon sufficient cause). Under Section 10, conciliation without monetary settlement can be requested. Under Section 11, IC must conduct inquiry following principles of natural justice within 90 days. During inquiry, complainant can seek interim transfer, 3 months paid leave, or restraint on respondent.

marginal_heading: Conditions Precedent to Retrenchment of Workmen & Compensation
text: No workman employed in any industry who has been in continuous service for not less than 1 year shall be retrenched until: (a) workman has been given 1 month notice in writing indicating reasons for retrenchment or wages in lieu thereof; (b) workman has been paid retrenchment compensation equivalent to 15 days average pay for every completed year of continuous service or any part thereof in excess of 6 months; (c) notice in prescribed manner served on appropriate government.

marginal_heading: Statutory Entitlement to Gratuity (5-Year Continuous Service Mandate)
text: Gratuity shall be payable to an employee on the termination of his employment after he has rendered continuous service for not less than 5 years: (a) on superannuation/retirement; (b) on resignation; (c) on death or disablement (5-year threshold waived). Formula: (15 * Last Drawn Basic + DA * Number of Completed Years of Service) / 26. Maximum tax-free statutory limit is Rs. 20 lakh. Forfeiture permitted only for damage wilfully caused or offences involving moral turpitude.
